title: Hospitality and Visiting with Personal Pronouns

sections.content:
Hosting friends in Hungary blends these pronoun sets seamlessly:
- **Gyertek hozzánk!** = Come over to our place! (Allative)
- **Maradjatok nálunk!** = Stay at our place! (Adessive)
- **Köszönjetek el tőlük!** = Say goodbye to them! (Ablative)
- **Mit kértek tőlünk?** = What can we get you? (Ablative)

items.english: The whole group is at our place.
We went over to their place for dinner.
